scope: P1 provenance verification; canonical promotion intentionally deferred.

acquisition.conflict_note: A Steam PQ guide lists Rough Ranger in the displayed basic reward set, while Dragon Ball Wiki explicitly describes it as a random Future Warrior reward after Ultimate Finish. The repository's existing skill-catalog audit and Batch 215 already preserve the Ultimate Finish interpretation; this audit does not silently erase the source discrepancy.

mechanics.summary: Defensive counter stance. Strike/basic attacks trigger the kick response; Ki-based attacks trigger the barrier, with point-blank Ki Blast treated as the kick case.
mechanics.counter_trigger: Universal counter; documented against both Strike and Ki-based attacks, with point-blank Ki Blast exception.
mechanics.damage_context: A reviewed reference reports 15% kick damage and 5% barrier-contact damage; retained as contextual/version-sensitive evidence rather than a canonical numeric field.

guardrails: Preserve the PQ119 Ultimate Finish interpretation while recording the conflicting Steam reward presentation.
Do not promote contextual damage percentages as canonical version-invariant values.
Do not mutate oversized canonical catalogs without the supported builder/runtime.
